fiche: Petit poisson-bulle qui gonfle quand il a peur, il dérive en bancs dans les lagons tièdes et les coraux peu profonds.
apparence: Round puffer-like fish with smooth skin, short fins and a soft glowing belly; turquoise, deep blue and pale cyan.

stades.bebe: A tiny round turquoise ball with huge shiny eyes, two stubby fins and a little bubble above its head.
stades.enfant: A small tail fin and a pair of side fins appear, and soft rounded spikes bud along its back.
stades.ado: Its body becomes egg-shaped with longer frilly fins, and its spikes grow into flexible cyan quills.
stades.adulte: A plump fish able to inflate into a spiky blue sphere, with a glowing cyan belly and wide fan-shaped fins.
stades.ancien: A heavy old pufferfish with faded barnacle-covered quills, long whisker barbels like a beard and a ring of tiny bubbles orbiting it.

fiche: Petit amphibien des récifs qui marche sur ses nageoires arrière et collectionne les coquillages échoués.
apparence: Small upright fish-amphibian with webbed limbs, gill frills and a finned tail; teal, navy blue and violet.

stades.bebe: A round teal tadpole with big eyes, a tiny tail and no limbs, wearing a small shell on its head.
stades.enfant: Two stubby webbed legs and short arms sprout, and small pink gill frills appear on its cheeks.
stades.ado: It stands upright on longer legs, its tail grows a violet fin and a dorsal crest rises along its spine.
stades.adulte: A slender standing fish-person with large webbed hands, flowing gill frills, a sail-like crest and a spiral shell shoulder guard.
stades.ancien: An old hunched fish-sage leaning on a driftwood staff, with long drooping gill whiskers and shells encrusted on its back.

fiche: Minuscule crevette translucide qui vit en nuées scintillantes et éclaire l'eau froide la nuit.
apparence: Translucent shrimp with many thin legs, long antennae and glowing dots along the body; pale cyan, light violet and deep blue.

stades.bebe: A tiny see-through bean shape with two big black eyes and a single glowing cyan dot inside.
stades.enfant: A curled tail and a row of tiny legs appear, with two short antennae on its head.
stades.ado: Its body lengthens into segments, the antennae grow very long and a line of glowing dots runs down its sides.
stades.adulte: A large translucent shrimp with fan-shaped tail, many feathery swimming legs and bright cyan light spots pulsing along its armor.
stades.ancien: An elder shrimp with cloudy armor plates covered in tiny barnacles, drooping antennae like a long mustache and a soft halo of drifting light specks.

fiche: Anguille électrique qui se cache dans les épaves et grésille quand on la caresse.
apparence: Long eel body with a ribbon fin and electric markings; dark navy blue, electric cyan and a little yellow.

stades.bebe: A short chubby navy worm shape with big eyes and a tiny spark on the tip of its tail.
stades.enfant: Its body stretches longer, a thin ribbon fin grows along its back and small cyan stripes appear.
stades.ado: A pair of small pectoral fins and twin whisker-like feelers appear, and its stripes start to crackle with sparks.
stades.adulte: A long powerful eel with a wide flowing fin, glowing lightning-shaped cyan stripes and crackling arcs around its jaws.
stades.ancien: A very long old eel with scarred skin, long white feelers like a beard and a faint ring of static floating over its head.

fiche: Crabe bagarreur qui se fabrique une armure avec tout ce qu'il ramasse sur le fond marin.
apparence: Wide crab with a round shell, eight legs and two claws; deep blue shell, purple joints and turquoise claw tips.

stades.bebe: A tiny round blue shell with two big eyes on stalks and two little pincers, no visible legs.
stades.enfant: Short stubby walking legs appear and one claw grows bigger than the other.
stades.ado: Its shell widens and gets spiky edges, and both claws become large and jagged.
stades.adulte: A broad armored crab with massive hammer-shaped claws, a spiked shell plated with pieces of scrap and shells, and thick purple legs.
stades.ancien: An old giant crab with a cracked shell overgrown by sea moss and small corals, and a sea anemone growing on its back like a hat.

fiche: Petit poulpe malin qui change de couleur et vole les objets brillants des plongeurs.
apparence: Soft octopus with a round head and curling tentacles; violet, deep blue and turquoise spots.

stades.bebe: A round violet head blob with huge eyes and four tiny nub tentacles.
stades.enfant: It grows eight short curly tentacles with little suction cups and turquoise spots on its head.
stades.ado: Its head becomes taller and pointed, tentacles lengthen and a frilly web of skin forms between them.
stades.adulte: A large octopus with long patterned tentacles, glowing turquoise rings that flash, and a wide skin cape between its arms.
stades.ancien: An old octopus with a wrinkled head, faded rings, tentacles holding a pearl and a broken shell monocle on one eye.

fiche: Poisson des grandes profondeurs qui attire ses proies avec la petite lanterne qui pend devant sa bouche.
apparence: Dark deep-sea fish with a huge mouth, needle teeth and a glowing lure on a stalk; black-blue, violet and bright cyan light.

stades.bebe: A small round dark blue fish with big eyes and a tiny glowing bulb on its forehead.
stades.enfant: The bulb rises on a short stalk, its mouth widens and small fins appear.
stades.ado: Its jaw grows large with rows of thin teeth, the stalk lengthens and glowing spots appear along its sides.
stades.adulte: A big deep-sea fish with an enormous fanged mouth, a long curved lure shining bright cyan and spiny dark fins.
stades.ancien: An ancient lure-fish with cracked dark skin, a lure that has become a crystal lantern and long thread-like fins trailing like robes.

fiche: Éponge vivante et gluante qui filtre l'eau des grottes sous-marines et absorbe tout ce qu'elle touche.
apparence: Porous sponge blob with holes and soft tubes, dripping slime; turquoise, purple and pale yellow.

stades.bebe: A small soft turquoise lump full of tiny holes, with two big eyes and a smiling mouth.
stades.enfant: Short hollow tubes sprout from its top like chimneys and puff little bubbles.
stades.ado: Its body grows lumpy and wider, the tubes get longer and purple slimy tendrils hang from its sides.
stades.adulte: A large spongy mass with many tall chimney tubes, wide pores glowing inside and thick slime arms that can grab things.
stades.ancien: An enormous old sponge mound covered in moss and tiny shells, with a crown of hardened white tubes like a coral crown.

fiche: Céphalopode à coquille spirale qui monte et descend dans l'eau comme un sous-marin et parle par éclats de lumière.
apparence: Coiled spiral shell with a tentacled face poking out; pearl white shell with deep blue stripes, violet tentacles and cyan eyes.

stades.bebe: A small round shell like a snail with a cute face and two tiny tentacles peeking out.
stades.enfant: The shell starts to coil into a spiral with blue stripes, and a ring of short tentacles appears around its face.
stades.ado: The spiral shell grows ridged and larger, a hood plate covers its head and glowing cyan eyes appear.
stades.adulte: A large spiral shell with sharp ridges and spikes, a crown of many long tentacles and bright cyan light pulsing from its shell chambers.
stades.ancien: An ancient nautilus with a fossil-like cracked shell covered in runes and barnacles, and long white beard-like tentacles.

fiche: Raie géante qui plane dans les courants comme un oiseau et bondit parfois hors de l'eau sous la lune.
apparence: Flat diamond-shaped ray with wide wing fins and a whip tail; deep blue back, white belly and glowing turquoise patterns.

stades.bebe: A small flat round pancake shape with big eyes on top and two tiny wing nubs.
stades.enfant: Its sides stretch into small triangular wing fins and a short thin tail appears.
stades.ado: Its wings grow wide and pointed, two curled head fins appear and turquoise star patterns cover its back.
stades.adulte: A huge gliding ray with vast wing fins, a long whip tail with a glowing tip and shining turquoise patterns like constellations.
stades.ancien: An ancient ray with frayed wing edges, barnacles and remoras clinging to it, and its glowing patterns turned silvery like a halo.

fiche: Homard chevalier qui se dresse sur ses pattes arrière pour défendre les épaves où il a établi son fief.
apparence: Upright armored lobster knight with segmented plates, long antennae and two huge claws; dark blue, purple and turquoise highlights.

stades.bebe: A small curled blue larva with big eyes, a fan tail and two tiny soft claws.
stades.enfant: Its claws harden and grow, segmented armor plates form and short antennae sprout.
stades.ado: It starts to stand upright on its back legs, one claw grows into a shield shape and the other into a pincer blade.
stades.adulte: A tall lobster knight standing upright, with a shield claw, a sword-like pincer claw, layered purple armor and long whip antennae.
stades.ancien: An old lobster knight with scratched armor covered in coral, broken antennae and a tattered brown kelp cape hanging from its shoulders.

fiche: Calmar géant des fosses obscures qui fait monter les marées en battant de ses immenses bras.
apparence: Long torpedo squid with triangular head fins, giant eyes and many arms; deep violet, navy blue and bright cyan photophores.

stades.bebe: A tiny violet capsule shape with two enormous eyes and a fringe of very short arms.
stades.enfant: A pair of small triangular fins appears on its head and its arms grow longer with suckers.
stades.ado: Its body stretches into a torpedo, two long hunting tentacles with club tips appear and cyan light dots form along its mantle.
stades.adulte: A giant squid with a huge glowing eye, wide arrow-shaped fins, a mass of long arms with hooked suckers and rows of bright cyan lights.
stades.ancien: A colossal elder squid with scarred mantle, white whale-tooth trophies stuck in its skin and a pale ghostly halo of light around its head.

fiche: Tortue colossale dont la carapace porte un récif de corail entier, abri de milliers de petits poissons.
apparence: Massive sea turtle with flipper legs and a coral reef growing on its shell; turquoise skin, deep blue shell and pink and violet corals.

stades.bebe: A small round turtle with a smooth blue shell, big eyes and four tiny flippers.
stades.enfant: Small coral buds sprout on its shell and its flippers grow longer with claws.
stades.ado: Its shell becomes ridged and wide, coral branches grow taller and a sharp beak forms.
stades.adulte: A huge four-legged turtle with thick armored flipper-legs, a beaked head and a full colorful coral reef with anemones on its shell.
stades.ancien: An ancient turtle with a deeply cracked shell carrying a reef with tiny sunken ruins, long white beard and calm glowing eyes.

fiche: Serpent de mer aux nageoires tranchantes qui fend les vagues des tempêtes et coule les navires imprudents.
apparence: Very long sea serpent with blade-like fins and scaled body; deep blue, turquoise fins and silver blade edges.

stades.bebe: A short round little sea snake with big eyes and a tiny frilly fin on its head.
stades.enfant: Its body lengthens with visible scales and a small fin crest appears along its back.
stades.ado: The back fins turn into sharp blade-shaped spines and two long frill fins open behind its head.
stades.adulte: A gigantic coiling sea serpent with a row of silver-edged blade fins, a wide fan frill around its head and glowing cyan eyes.
stades.ancien: An ancient serpent with chipped blade fins, barnacle-crusted scales, a long kelp mane and an old anchor chain wrapped around its body.

fiche: Reine des abysses, immense méduse couronnée dont la lumière guide toutes les créatures des profondeurs.
apparence: Giant crowned jellyfish with a translucent bell, glowing veins and endless ribbon tentacles; violet, deep blue and luminous cyan.

stades.bebe: A tiny translucent violet bell with big eyes and a single short glowing tentacle.
stades.enfant: A ring of thin tentacles appears under its bell and soft cyan veins light up inside it.
stades.ado: Its bell becomes tall and scalloped, frilly ribbon arms grow under it and a small spiky crest rises on top.
stades.adulte: A colossal glowing jellyfish queen with a scalloped bell, a crown of light spikes, long trailing ribbon arms and hundreds of shining tentacles.
stades.ancien: An ancient queen jellyfish with a larger star-shaped crown, a halo of floating pearls and tiny moons, and tentacles flowing like a royal train.
